fieldValues.title: Addressability
fieldValues.extension_adds: The live cursor over the core Address (RFC-049): the current focus of an active process run, `AttentionState`, stamped onto conversation material as it is produced, so that asking for everything said while attention was on a given field becomes a query, not a search, together with the context-query behaviour built on it. The Address itself, which makes a transcript fragment and a field on a record co-addressable, is core. For live facilitation, declare together with `ext:protocol`.
fieldValues.extension_cost_of_non_adoption: Without it, there is no live cursor stamped onto conversation material as it is produced: asking for everything said while attention was on a given field is not answerable as a query, and context assembly is retrospective only. Addresses themselves remain available, because the Address is core.
